def transform(grid):
    rows = [row for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i == 0 or row != grid[i - 1]]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if j == 0 or any(row[j] != row[j - 1] for row in grid)]
    return [[row[j] for j in cols] for row in rows]
